introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, slowly lift your left knee straight up. Inhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.
name: KNEE LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please do this exercise slowly and do not use the impulsive force.
Exhale as you lift your knee, and inhale as you lower it.
Please don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.
This exercise strengthens your hip flexors.

introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, slowly lift your right knee straight up. Inhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.

introduce:
Grip the left edge of the chair with your right hand.

Inhale, reach your left arm overhead. Exhale, lean your body to the right.

Hold this position, breathing deeply and steadily.
name: SIDE BEND REACH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Breathe deeply and steadily.
You can feel your obliques stretched.
This exercise is good for your lower back.

introduce:
Grip the right edge of the chair with your left hand.

Inhale, reach your right arm overhead. Exhale, lean your body to the left.

Hold this position, breathing deeply and steadily.
name: SIDE BEND REACH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Breathe deeply and steadily.
You can feel your obliques stretched.
This exercise is good for your lower back.

introduce:
Bend your arms and place your fingertips on your shoulders.

Rotate your elbows clockwise in big circles several times, then rotate counterclockwise.

Maintain steady breathing. Repeat this exercise.
name: SEATED BENT ARM CIRCLES

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Breathe regularly.
This exercise works your upper and inner chest muscles.
This exercise helps warm up your shoulders and activate your upper body.

introduce: Bend your elbows at 90 degrees with your upper arms out to your sides, keeping them parallel to the floor and your palms facing forward.\n\nExhale, press your forearms against each other. Inhale, return to the starting position. Repeat.
name: SEATED BENT ARM CHEST FLY

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Exhale as you press your forearms together, and inhale as you return.
Keep your back straight.
Feel the squeeze on your chest.
Press your forearms against each other as hard as you can.
Keep your arms at a 90 degree angle.
This exercise activates your upper back muscles and improves your posture.

introduce:
Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Exhale, hinge forward from the hips, using your left hand to push your knee down toward the ground.

Hold for a few seconds, breathing deeply and steadily.
name: CHAIR GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your back straight.
Please relax your hips.
Breathe regularly.
To make a deeper stretch, pull your crossed leg closer to your body.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and glutes and can reduce your lower back pain.

introduce:

Hold for a few seconds, breathing deeply and steadily.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.

introduce:
Interlock your fingers and turn your palms upwards.

Inhale, lengthen your spine and stretch your arms toward the ceiling.

Gently move your shoulders down and back to enhance the stretch in your upper back.

Keep your neck neutral. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR PALM TREE POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Keep your back straight.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This pose can wake up the muscles of your shoulders and back.
This pose helps increase the flexibility of your back, shoulders and arms.

introduce: Take a deep breath and as you exhale, slowly curl your chin to your chest, draw your lower belly in and round your back.\n\nFold your body and press your entire palms on the floor. With every exhalation, move your chest and shoulders away from your thighs. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This pose helps to release tightness in your neck, shoulders, lower back, and hips.

introduce:
Sit on the edge of the chair. Inhale, open your left leg out towards the left. Make sure your knee is aligned with your ankle, pointing in the same direction as your toes and forming a 90-degree angle.

Exhale, extend your right leg to the right with your toes facing forward. Raise your arms to your sides at shoulder height with your palms down.

Draw your belly in, tuck your tailbone down, and lift your chest. Take your gaze to your left hand. Hold this position.
name: CHAIR WARRIOR II LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Don't let your bent knee go over your toes.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears and keep them relaxed.
This exercise strengthens your lower body and shoulders.

introduce:
